title: digisnake
author: Robbie
description: A Cartesian step sequencer after MDD Snake (and Make Noise's Rene): eight steps in a 4 x 2 grid that matches knobs A-H, walked by a path in one of seven shapes (ROWS, SNAKE, COLS, ZIGZAG, DIAG, CORNER, HOP), forwards, backwards, ping-pong or at random. Per track, synth and MIDI: NOTES (semitones from NOTE, quantised to a scale in the keyboard's ROOT), GATES and VELOCITY pages, and a PATH page (ON, SHAPE, DIR, LEN, DIV: 1/8, 1/4, 1/2, 1X or 2X (1/2 plays every other step, eighth notes at 16th steps), the track at twice its speed in per-track SCALE mode, SCALE, RANGE, SHIFT), saved with the project. The page is TRIG's next page (press TRIG again) on synth and MIDI tracks, or SNAKE in core-dn1's Mod Menu; LEFT/RIGHT change page, hold TRIG + YES randomises a page (PATH: all but SNAKE and SCALE), hold TRIG + REC copies a page and TRIG + STOP pastes it onto another track, TRIG + PLAY clears it, TRIG + FUNC + REC prints the snake into the track's own trigs, notes and velocities and turns SNAKE off, FUNC + YES all of them, hold TRIG + NO goes back to how the snake was when TRIG went down, FUNC + NO to before a run of FUNC + YES, FUNC + a knob jumps (NOTES by octaves, VELOCITY by quarters, RANGE 0/12/24). On OS 1.44 the stock drop-down message names what happened, and the snake survives a power cycle. With DIRECT JUMP 1.4 or later in the build, a pattern start (START ON BAR) relaunches every snake from its path's start, with the pattern. For OS 1.43 and 1.44; needs core-dn1 3.3 and seq-events.
